text: 金十数据8月2日讯，中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议指出，金融服务重点领域和薄弱环节质效提升。加强金融“五篇大文章”工作统筹和政策落实，研究优化科技金融、绿色金融等统计和评价制度。聚焦扩大内需、科技创新和中小微企业等重点领域，下调结构性货币政策工具利率，增加科技创新和技术改造再贷款、支农支小再贷款额度并单设民营企业再贷款，合并设立科技创新与民营企业债券风险分担工具，拓展服务消费与养老再贷款、碳减排支持工具支持领域。6月末，金融“五篇大文章”贷款同比增长11%，明显高于全部贷款增速。债券市场“科技板”累计发行科技创新债券超过2.8万亿元。规范
text_en: Jin Shi Data, Aug 2 – The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference. The meeting noted improved quality and efficiency of financial services to key areas and weak links. Coordination and policy implementation for the 'five major articles' of finance will be strengthened, with research on optimizing statistical and evaluation systems for technology finance, green finance, and others. Focusing on key areas including expanding domestic demand, technology innovation, and SMEs, rates on structural monetary policy tools were lowered, quotas for technology innovation and technical transformation re-lending and agricultural and small-enterprise re-lending increased with a dedicated private enterprise re-lending facility created, a bond risk-sharing tool for technology innovation and private enterprises was jointly established, and support areas for services consumption and elderly care re-lending and the carbon-reduction support tool were expanded. At end-June, loans under the 'five major articles' of finance grew 11% year on year, notably higher than overall loan growth.
